goal: Implement the first bounded Mod Engineer slice: pure Java coordinate utilities, mana math, sparse positional chunk storage, and a no-dependency executable test. The worker may inspect the full target directory but may write only the four declared files.
done: All four scoped files exist and compile with Java 25 without Minecraft or Fabric classes.
Unset positions read as zero; non-positive results are removed so storage remains sparse; mana never becomes negative or non-finite.
Coordinate helpers handle negative coordinates and chunk boundaries using floor division/modulus semantics.
ChunkManaMapTest is a no-dependency executable test whose main method covers get, set, add, remove, sparse cleanup, invalid values, negative coordinates, and chunk boundaries.
forbidden: Do not write outside the four declared files, although the full target may be read.
Do not use Minecraft, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, client, networking, persistence, mixin, package-manager, download, network, subagent, or MCP APIs.
Do not edit design, creative, build, mod-spec, agent-state, or repository instruction files.
Do not claim Gradle or Minecraft integration is complete.
